coordinates.object_orientation: Spire apex +Z; base Z=0; aperture facing camera -Y and placed on +X side in front view, matching primary right-hand aperture view. Keep dextral winding; do not mirror. Center X/Y.

concept.reason: Primary fossil plate already shows back, top and aperture-side views with scale, plus a corroborating same-species plate. Generating concepts would not add needed evidence.

scope: Original low-poly fossil shell interpretation, not an exact specimen scan or a living snail. Use PRI70343-1 three-view plate; PRI70342 provides same-species corroboration only.

scale.basis: PRI70343-1 reference 1 cm bar approximately131 px tall; shell approximately316 px tall, so height approximately24 mm. Shell width approximately170 px, about13 mm; round top supports comparable depth.
scale.uncertainty: Image estimates only, not caliper measurements; about10–15% interpretation tolerance. Do not substitute the differently sized PRI70342 scale.

required_features: Straight to gently convex tapering conical body, broad high shoulder narrowing to small anterior base; body whorl occupies about75–80% total height.
Short stepped cone-shaped spire and visible spiral sutures; it rises above shoulder, not a tall tower or a completely flat disk.
Long narrow aperture down one side, extending from just under shoulder to anterior base; preserve genuinely open slot with an inner lining and thin continuous outer lip.
Top view clearly shows dextral spiral whorls/sutures and asymmetric aperture notch; no concentric stacked plates pretending to be a spiral.
Solid-looking closed convex shell back; no random through-holes. The small drilled hole on PRI70342 is damage and must not be copied.
Use a slightly truncated/open anterior termination consistent with the narrow shell mouth, not a stretched siphonal canal.
simplifications: Omit museum handwriting, chips, drilling damage and fine surface scratches.
Keep subtle broad fossil-ivory coloration; living spotted pattern is not needed and must not be invented as preserved evidence.
No soft animal, operculum, texture photo, or downloaded scan mesh.
Deep hidden interior coiling need not be modeled; visible aperture lining must be real geometry.
acceptance_focus: Front and perspective show continuous narrow opening, not painted black stripe or detached long blade.
Top view and side preserve tapered shell volume, short spire and chirality.
Silhouette and body/spire proportions match primary three-view reference within declared low-poly interpretation.
Apply required GLB/source checks and two cheap isolated rebuilds; four standard final views only unless issue-specific reason is recorded.
maker_notes: Retain this directory through prep/making/QA; maker reports then FINAL, no backup or deletion task.
Source reference photos carry CC BY-NC-SA4.0 and must stay private, never become textures or public delivery files. Model geometry/code must be original.
PRI70343-1 tip/lip wear need not be exactly reproduced; do not claim exact scan fidelity.
Before final render compare cheap front/top/side gray previews against primary reference, then produce standard four views.
